title: Holiday queen size quilt
text: Holiday queen size quilt. I love quilts because they are machine wash/dry.  This quilt did beautifully in the wash/dry.  I will say that this quilt is surprisingly thin and light - which is fine for me - but I was surprised at how thin and light it was. They describe it as a coverlet - maybe they are lighter than a regular quilt?  The colors are predominately soft white and Christmas red with a soft gray.  I love the color mix.  There are snowflakes, elk like animals (not moose) and stripes.  Very festive but not cartoonish.  The pillow slipcovers are of average size... maybe a bit weak in the back - its a thin, fold over material.  I do worry about this a bit as I have heavy memory foam pillows I use for the slipcovers and I hope it won't tear.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
